input.in.content:
#cmakedefine ENABLED "@TITLE@"
#cmakedefine DISABLED disabled
#cmakedefine01 ENABLED
#cmakedefine01 DISABLED
at=@TITLE@

script.cmake.content:
set(ENABLED ON)
set(DISABLED OFF)
set(TITLE [=[A "quote"]=])
configure_file(input.in out/config.h @ONLY ESCAPE_QUOTES)

set(VALUE changed)
configure_file(input.in raw.txt COPYONLY)
configure_file(input.in expanded.txt)
